statement:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  1 ≤ n →
    ∀ (x : ℝ),
      Tendsto (fun m => if 0 < x ∧ x < 1 / (↑m + 1) then ↑m + 1 else 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
        (∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..1, if 0 < y ∧ y < 1 / ↑n then ↑n else 0) = 1

goal.text:
Tendsto (fun m => if 0 < x ∧ x < 1 / (↑m + 1) then ↑m + 1 else 0) atTop (𝓝 0) ∧
  (∫ (y : ℝ) in 0..1, if 0 < y ∧ y < 1 / ↑n then ↑n else 0) = 1
